summary: Three 100 W panels in 3S feed a SmartSolar 100/20: 20 A maximum charge and physical LOAD output. Two matched local 12 V / 150 Ah batteries use 8 AWG branches; controller wiring is 10 AWG and short LOAD wiring 12 AWG. CHTAIXI supplies polarized 10 A PV/load protection; required 30 A non-polarized DIHOOL battery/controller protection has conflicting published specifications to resolve. Owner reference enclosure is the ANIMACYN B0CT5LRGRF ventilated ABS box, 13.8 × 9.7 × 5.9 inches, previously used for Pasana Group / PNG. Keep it out of the current order; determine the final fit by hand-assembling the components before ordering the box. Capped USB-A/USB-C female extensions remain. The 165 W load envelope has no inverter. The ordered BMV-700 adds bank state of charge through its included 500 A / 50 mV shunt and wired display; its fused sense/power lead is the only added battery-bus load. Purchase evidence is retained in the private Polowat ledger.

powerModel.assumptions: Daily budget remains 520 Wh: Starlink 40 W × 8 h, laptop 70 Wh, phones 30 Wh, conversion/control/reserve 100 Wh. Solar 300 W × 4 PSH × 75% = 900 Wh/day is a weather-dependent estimate including clipping/field losses. Expected simultaneous device maximum is 60/0.85 + 78 = 148.6 W before wiring losses; full 72 W converter envelope is 72/0.85 + 78 = 162.7 W, rounded to 165 W. The 85% converter efficiency is an acceptance assumption, not a published guarantee. At 11.8 V, 165 W is 13.98 A. Require ≥11.5 V at converters under load. BatteryLife does not guarantee an 11.8 V floor: configure user-defined LOAD disconnect 11.8 V and provisional reconnect 13.1 V, then validate against the exact battery chemistry. No continuous-load expansion beyond 20 A. The BMV-700 electronics use <1.152 Wh/day at 12 V with backlight off. Its 500 A / 50 mV shunt adds 0.04 W at 20 A (2 mV drop); both fit within the existing 100 Wh conversion/control reserve. No change to the 520 Wh/day budget.

loadBudget.basis: Daily reserve; peak includes full converter envelope and wiring overhead; includes BMV electronics (<1.152 Wh/day at 12 V, backlight off) and shunt losses

bom.description: CHTAIXI 10 A two-pole DC breaker, Amazon 600 V DC claim. 1.5625 × 5.16 A Isc = 8.06 A; 10 A stays below the provisional Renogy 15 A maximum series protection. bom.item: DIHOOL 30 A non-polarized battery breakers · candidate on hold
bom.description: Two 30 A non-polarized battery-branch breakers, both inside the main junction box, on 8 AWG cable. Charging and discharging reverse current on these conductors. The exact Amazon product photos show DZ47X-63, 30 A, non-polarized, 12–500 VDC and Icu 6 kA; the parameter image specifies a C curve. This establishes the advertised voltage range, not an independently verified test result. The Amazon bullet still limits its short-circuit claim to 48 V and above, while DIHOOL’s generic family page gives 4 kA/B-curve data. Resolve this variant/documentation mismatch before accepting the breaker as sole battery-fault protection. Final two-pole wiring, received fine-stranded conductor preparation and torque, actual battery fault current and parallel-source backfeed coordination remain installation checks. MidNite is excluded. Battery isolators are inside the main junction box by owner request. Battery-to-box positive leads are upstream of their breakers: a fault there cannot be cleared by those downstream breakers. Source-end fault protection, mechanical guarding and parallel-bank backfeed coordination remain unresolved; keep leads shortest-practical. Moving a breaker does not extend its protection upstream.

operatingRules: Use Starlink Mini integrated Wi-Fi and the specified USB charger only; no inverter or unmodeled battery-bus loads.
Confirm a transferable Starlink kit and service permitted at the exact Micronesia location; recurring service is outside this hardware budget.

Parallel only matched batteries of the same chemistry/model/age and equal rested voltage. Each branch is sized for 20 A with the other isolated, but this does not guarantee automatic isolation of internal battery faults.

Open the relevant 30 A battery breaker before servicing; connected PV and the other battery can still energize buses and wiring. Follow the complete isolation procedure and verify dead before cutting.

Set user-defined LOAD disconnect to 11.8 V and provisional reconnect to 13.1 V, subject to battery-maker acceptance. BatteryLife alone does not enforce this floor. Stop laptop charging first when energy is low.
Keep both converter positives and returns on the physical LOAD output through the two branch circuits. No return, USB shield or external ground path may bypass LOAD−.
Keep panels unshaded and mounted to a wind-qualified roof system. Keep electronics dry, screened and outside the battery-gas path; preserve all guards and strain relief.

BMV-700: monitor the combined bank, keep backlight timeout enabled, set 300 Ah for both batteries or 150 Ah after isolating one, and synchronize only at confirmed full charge using battery-specific settings. Battery percentage is an estimate; retain controller LOAD disconnect.
commissioning: Record exact local battery model, chemistry, terminals, charge limits, internal resistance/fault-current data, weight and price. Separately charge to equal rested voltage before paralleling; configure the correct charge profile and disable unsupported equalization.

Verify 8 AWG battery and 10 AWG controller cable has ≥30 A ampacity after ambient, bundling, terminal and insulation limits. Verify 12 AWG shared LOAD wire ≥25 A and post-breaker branches ≥10 A. Check conductor area, strand class, ferrules, rings, crimp die and all terminal torques.

Measure all routes: battery-to-bus ≤2 m one way, bus-to-controller ≤0.5 m, shared LOAD ≤0.25 m plus each downstream branch ≤0.75 m, ≤1 m total from controller to converter; PV ≤10 m one way. Battery and converter limits follow the owner’s estimates; 0.5 m bus/controller and 10 m PV remain assumptions, not measured cuts. Recalculate if longer or hotter.

Battery first, verify 12 V detection and correct charge settings, then connect LOAD circuits and PV per Victron. Set user-defined 11.8 V disconnect; validate provisional 13.1 V reconnect with battery maker and test non-chattering recovery.

Verify converter factory lead ampacity and exact Phoenix terminal fit; use an approved enclosed transition if needed. Test full Starlink OEM cable at startup and simultaneous USB load with ≥11.5 V at converter inputs; measure efficiency, inrush, voltage drop and temperature.

Test both batteries together and each alone for at least two hours at the simultaneous design load. Measure battery-to-MPPT voltage drop, charge voltage at actual posts, all terminal temperatures and enclosure ambient; Victron full 20 A output requires ≤40°C ambient.
Resolve site bonding, earth, ground-fault and lightning requirements. Do not ground either PV pole or create a LOAD− bypass; exact earth conductor sizing remains unassigned pending the site design.

Ancor wire is rated 105°C dry but 75°C wet; installation must keep this DC cable dry. For the 12 AWG shared LOAD pair, verify ≥25 A derated ampacity: the manufacturer’s 4–6 conductor non-engine bundle example is 27 A, while its 7–24 conductor example falls to 22.5 A. Route the shared pair separately from larger bundles; terminal/local installation limits still apply.

The exact Amazon product photos show DZ47X-63, 30 A, non-polarized, 12–500 VDC and Icu 6 kA; the parameter image specifies a C curve. This establishes the advertised voltage range, not an independently verified test result. The Amazon bullet still limits its short-circuit claim to 48 V and above, while DIHOOL’s generic family page gives 4 kA/B-curve data. Resolve this variant/documentation mismatch before accepting the breaker as sole battery-fault protection.

Actual battery model, prospective fault current, charge limits, terminals, terminal guarding, retention and equal-length routes remain unknown. Parallel-battery bus-end backfeed requires clearing-energy coordination or additional protection.

Received Ancor 8/12 AWG and iGreely 10 AWG PV/controller wire markings, hot/bundled ampacity and terminal compatibility must be verified. Exact 8 AWG battery-post lugs and a matched crimper remain unpriced.

USB-A BATIGE extension lacks published current/QC and formal IP ratings. Confirm ≥3 A and required charging profiles/sealing, or choose a documented alternative. USB-C PD pass-through must be checked in both orientations. Ports are sheltered while charging; close caps when unused.

Owner reference is ANIMACYN B0CT5LRGRF, 13.8 × 9.7 × 5.9 inches, previously used for Pasana Group / PNG. Do not stage the enclosure. Hand-assemble components and establish actual dimensions before ordering it; no internal-fit drawing is released. Preserve controller mounting/cooling requirements during that assembly.

Use the reference box’s ventilation; no separate QWORK vent. Check temperature with the final cover closed at full charge and load. The approximate 25–35 W heat allowance is not a guarantee of thermal fit; maintain ≤40°C MPPT ambient for full output.
Separate guarded battery-breaker housings, finish labels/guards, Starlink entry/activation, roof attachment and bonding remain pending. No completed-system IP rating is established.

P9 terminal-level mockup is an assembly study, not a released fabrication drawing: 325 × 424 mm workspace exceeds reference enclosure outside footprint. Exact converter dimensions, clamp/plug access, gland cuts and collision-free cable bend envelopes need received hardware. One contiguous ten-block DK10N rail uses supplied single end cover and two stops. No box order until owner assembly. DIHOOL protection remains held.

Owner intends to use the enclosure’s plastic mounting grid and has removed the Tynulox sheet from procurement. Victron requires a nonflammable substrate for the SmartSolar: plastic-grid compliance has not been established. Resolve a suitable controller mounting surface before installation; no replacement plate is staged or priced.

Verify shunt polarity, all charge/load paths through its system side and no LOAD− bypass. Fit two 10 AWG M10 lugs, keep supplied 1 A slow-blow sense fuse near BATT+ and carry spares. Verify 52 mm display body/cutout, rear RJ12 clearance, dry mounting and actual enclosure fit.

electricalAudit.pvExpansionReview: Retain the 10 A PV disconnect for the present 3S string (4.84 A Imp / 5.16 A Isc; 8.06 A sizing basis).
